split.algorithm: numpy default_rng SeedSequence([seed,subject]); class order 0,1; first10 permutation indices per class calibration, remaining40 fit; sorted trial indices

normalization: fit per-channel float64 mean/std+1e-6 on 80 fit trials only; apply to calibration and test

calibration.temperature_per: participant x condition x initialization seed
calibration.optimizer: scipy minimize_scalar bounded in log(T); xatol1e-10 maxiter500
calibration.candidates: T1, lower endpoint, upper endpoint, optimizer; min NLL; ties within1e-12 prefer first (T1)
calibration.score_mapping: legacy float32 network probabilities; Walsh bit clip1e-7 Bernoulli class log scores; S0 log softmax probabilities clip1e-12

design.scope: exploratory calibration diagnostic after prior Lee results were inspected
design.independent_unit: participant after averaging five initialization seeds
design.test: 100 offline Day-2 trials; global model and T freeze before first test array read
design.primary_comparison: same newly refitted model before vs after class-score temperature scaling

analysis.primary: within-condition paired participant delta stable NLL (calibrated minus raw)
analysis.intervals: pointwise unadjusted 95% paired-delta t confidence intervals
analysis.secondary: ECE15 and summed multiclass Brier descriptive
